# `/workflows` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /workflows/v1

`listWorkflowsV1` — List workflows

List all workflows in the tenant.

- Scopes: sp:workflow:manage, sp:workflow:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of workflow

### POST /workflows/v1

`createWorkflowV1` — Create workflow

Create a new workflow with the desired trigger and steps specified in the request body.

- Scopes: sp:workflow:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): object
- Returns 200: workflow

### GET /workflows/v1/{id}

`getWorkflowV1` — Get workflow by id

Get a single workflow by id.

- Scopes: sp:workflow:manage, sp:workflow:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Id of the workflow
- Returns 200: workflow

### PUT /workflows/v1/{id}

`putWorkflowV1` — Update workflow

Perform a full update of a workflow. The updated workflow object is returned in the response.

- Scopes: sp:workflow:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Id of the Workflow
- Body (application/json): workflowbody
- Returns 200: workflow

### PATCH /workflows/v1/{id}

`patchWorkflowV1` — Patch workflow

Partially update an existing Workflow using [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) syntax.

- Scopes: sp:workflow:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Id of the Workflow
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: workflow

### DELETE /workflows/v1/{id}

`deleteWorkflowV1` — Delete workflow by id

Delete a workflow. **Enabled workflows cannot be deleted**. They must first be disabled.

- Scopes: sp:workflow:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Id of the Workflow
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /workflows/v1/{id}/test

`testWorkflowV1` — Test workflow by id

:::info Workflow must be disabled in order to use this endpoint. ::: Test a workflow with the provided input data. The input data should resemble the input that the trigger will send the workflow. See the [event trigger documentation](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/extensibility/event-triggers/available) for an example input for the trigger that initiates this workflow. This endpoint will return an execution ID, which can be used to lookup more information about the execution using the…

- Scopes: sp:workflow-execute:external
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Id of the workflow
- Body (application/json): object
- Returns 200: object

### GET /workflows/v1/{id}/executions

`getWorkflowExecutionsV1` — List workflow executions — **DEPRECATED**

By default, you can get a maximum of 250 executions. To get executions past the first 250 records, you can do the following: 1. Use the [Get Workflows](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/list-workflows-v-1) endpoint to get your workflows. 2. Get your workflow ID from the response. 3. You can then do…

- Scopes: sp:workflow-execution:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Workflow ID.
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: start_time: eq, lt, le, gt, ge; status: eq — e.g. `status eq "Failed"`
- Returns 200: array of workflowexecution

### POST /workflows/v1/{id}/external/oauth-clients

`createWorkflowExternalTriggerV1` — Generate external trigger oauth client

Create OAuth client ID, client secret, and callback URL for use in an external trigger. External triggers will need this information to generate an access token to authenticate to the callback URL and submit a trigger payload that will initiate the workflow.

- Scopes: sp:workflow:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Id of the workflow
- Returns 200: workflowoauthclient

### POST /workflows/v1/execute/external/{id}

`createExternalExecuteWorkflowV1` — Execute workflow via external trigger

This endpoint allows a service outside of IdentityNow to initiate a workflow that uses the "External Trigger" step. The external service will invoke this endpoint with the input data it wants to send to the workflow in the body.

- Scopes: sp:workflow-execute:external
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Id of the workflow
- Body (application/json): object
- Returns 200: object

### POST /workflows/v1/execute/external/{id}/test

`testExternalExecuteWorkflowV1` — Test workflow via external trigger

Validate a workflow with an "External Trigger" can receive input. The response includes the input that the workflow received, which can be used to validate that the input is intact when it reaches the workflow.

- Scopes: sp:workflow-execute:external
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Id of the workflow
- Body (application/json): object
- Returns 200: object
